name: holla
description: Browser party games with built-in voice chat

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,green,cyan npm:dev:shared npm:dev:server npm:dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.sim: npm run build -w shared --silent && tsx scripts/sim.ts
